title: A Golden Week Family Adventure in Osaka: 7 days of neon-lit street food, theme parks & family magic in Japan's kitchen
description: Osaka during Golden Week is electric — the city hums with festival energy, street food sizzles on every corner, and families fill the parks and arcades with laughter. This itinerary is built around your home base at Fraser Residence Nankai in the heart of Namba, weaving your must-do requests (USJ, TeamLab, Cup Noodle Museum, Pokémon Center, and Kobe Sanda Premium Outlets) into a week of incredible food, culture, and pure family fun. Expect crowds — it's Golden Week — but with smart timing and local know-how, you'll navigate it like pros.

days.title: Arrival Day — Namba Neon & Street Food Feast
days.description: Settle into your home base at Fraser Residence Nankai and dive straight into Osaka's beating heart. Namba and Dotonbori are at your doorstep — the famous Glico Running Man sign, canal-side lights, and endless street food stalls are a 5-minute walk away.

activities.name: Check In at Fraser Residence Nankai Osaka
activities.description: Your serviced apartment is steps from Nankai Namba Station. Spacious rooms with full kitchens, washing machines, and space for the family. Stock up at nearby convenience stores. Walk north to Dotonbori — Osaka's most iconic street. The Glico Running Man sign, the giant crab at Kani Doraku, and the neon chaos are unforgettable. Start your food journey with takoyaki and okonomiyaki from the stalls.

days.title: Castle, Samurai & Retro Osaka
days.description: Start with Osaka's crown jewel — the magnificent castle with its moats and sprawling parkland. The museum brings samurai history alive for kids. Afternoon, explore retro Shinsekai with arcades and kushikatsu. Tonight, your first fine dining experience.

activities.name: Osaka Castle & Castle Park
activities.description: Take the Midosuji Line from Namba to Tanimachi 4-chome (10 min). The main tower is an 8-floor museum with samurai armour, swords, and panoramic observation deck. The park has playgrounds, moat boat rides, and open spaces.

activities.name: Shinsekai & Tsutenkaku Tower
activities.description: Head south to Shinsekai — Osaka's retro wonderland with neon signs and old-school arcades. Climb Tsutenkaku Tower for 360° city views, then explore the game arcades below.

days.title: Cup Noodles, Pokémon & Shopping
days.description: A day the kids will never forget — make your own Cup Noodles at the legendary Ikeda museum, then head back for Pokémon Center Osaka DX and a Shinsaibashi shopping spree.

activities.name: Cup Noodle Museum Osaka Ikeda
activities.description: Take Hankyu Takarazuka Line from Umeda to Ikeda (20 min). The highlight: My Cup Noodle Factory, where each family member designs a cup, picks soup and toppings. Hands-on, educational, delicious.

activities.name: Pokémon Center Osaka DX
activities.description: Head to Daimaru Shinsaibashi 9F for the massive Pokémon Center Osaka DX. Exclusive Osaka-only merch, plushies, cards, clothing. Pokémon Café next door — book ahead. 600m covered arcade with every brand imaginable. Great for souvenirs, Japanese sweets, and quirky finds at Don Quijote.

days.title: Kobe Sanda Premium Outlets & Kobe Beef
days.description: Day trip to Kobe Sanda Premium Outlets — 210+ stores in a stunning Andalusian village setting. Shop deals on Nike, Coach, Lego, and Japanese brands, then Kobe beef dinner in the city itself.

activities.name: Direct Bus to Kobe Sanda Premium Outlets
activities.description: Catch the direct bus from Namba OCAT (~70 min). Mediterranean-style village with 210+ stores and open-air walkways.

activities.name: Transfer to Kobe City
activities.description: Bus to JR Sanda Station, then JR Rapid to Sannomiya (50 min total). Stroll Meriken Park along Kobe's harbour if time allows.

days.title: Aquarium by Day, TeamLab by Night
days.description: Underwater wonders to digital art dreamscapes. Morning at Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan, then rest up before tomorrow's USJ. As sun sets, TeamLab Botanical Garden transforms Nagai Park into a magical light experience.

activities.name: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan
activities.description: Midosuji Line to Osakako Station (25 min from Namba). Spiral down 8 floors past 15 ocean environments centered around the massive Pacific Ocean tank with whale sharks and manta rays.

activities.name: Tempozan Ferris Wheel & Rest
activities.description: Giant Ferris Wheel with sweeping Osaka Bay views — choose the see-through gondola! Then head back to Fraser Residence for rest before USJ tomorrow.

activities.name: TeamLab Botanical Garden Osaka
activities.description: At sunset, trees light up as you approach, flowers bloom in digital colour, and the forest canopy becomes an immersive light canvas. Absolutely enchanting for all ages.

days.title: Universal Studios Japan — The Big Day!
days.description: The day the kids have been waiting for. A full day at USJ — Super Nintendo World, Wizarding World of Harry Potter, Minion Park, and more. May 5 is Children's Day and USJ goes all out. Get there early, stay late, make memories.

activities.name: Early Entry & Super Nintendo World
activities.description: Head straight to Super Nintendo World. Mario Kart: Koopa's Challenge is an AR masterpiece. Buy Power-Up Bands (¥4,200) to play interactive games throughout the land.

activities.name: Wizarding World of Harry Potter
activities.description: Hogsmeade village and Hogwarts Castle. The Forbidden Journey ride is phenomenal. Browse Ollivanders, try butterbeer, send a postcard from Owl Post. Despicable Me ride and Minion merch. Universal Wonderland is designed for younger kids — Sesame Street, Hello Kitty, Snoopy areas with gentle rides and character meets.

activities.name: Night Parade & Fireworks
activities.description: Stay for the night parade and seasonal fireworks. Park open until 9pm on peak Golden Week days. Parade usually starts at 7pm.

days.title: Market Morning & Farewell to Osaka
days.description: Your last morning — a relaxed farewell. Kuromon Market for sashimi breakfast, last-minute souvenirs, and one final walk through your Namba neighbourhood. If your flight is later, squeeze in Tennoji Park.

activities.name: Kuromon Market — Osaka's Kitchen
activities.description: Walk to Kuromon Market (10 min from Fraser Residence) — 150+ stalls of fresh sashimi, grilled seafood, tamago, and seasonal fruits. The perfect farewell breakfast.

activities.name: Last Souvenirs & Checkout
activities.description: Hit the depachika (basement food halls) of Takashimaya or Daimaru for beautifully packaged Japanese sweets. Check out and store luggage at hotel or Namba Station coin lockers.
